name: Saturn from Voyager 2, September 2, 1981, 00:27 UTC
blurb: The ringed planet, about 120,500 kilometers across at the equator. Seen by Voyager 2's narrow-angle camera through orange, green and blue filters: visible light only, 0.48 to 0.62 µm.
story: A view of Saturn, 7 days after Voyager 2's closest approach to Saturn on August 26, 1981. Its rings are billions of chunks of ice and rock, from dust-sized grains to pieces as big as a house.
